text:
Lina M: Morning team, I'm finishing my first week and trying to complete on-call onboarding. Need pager access + want to confirm which runtime runbook is gold (there are multiple copies). Also hit a permissions error when requesting the PD group in Okta.
Omar V: Welcome Lina! The single source we maintain is the Confluence runtime on-call page (internal link). GitHub has a snapshot but Confluence is authoritative. For PD access you need to be in the org:engineers group first.
Priya S: Added a short checklist for new oncall folks in thread: 1) Okta org group, 2) PagerDuty invite, 3) join #incidents, 4) shadow rotation scheduled.
Lina M: I tried joining org:engineers but Okta shows "group not visible" when I search.
IdP Team Bot: New group visibility request logged. Request ID: idp-88421. A human will follow up if auto-approval fails.
Omar V: That means the auto-provision step didn't run. @IdP Team Bot / @Priya S can escalate. Lina, can you paste your Okta username?
Lina M: lina.martinez@redwood.com
Priya S: Thanks. @IdP Team Bot I kicked off a manual sync for user lina.martinez@redwood.com.
IdP Team Bot: Manual sync initiated (sync-1765004350). Estimated completion ~2 minutes.
Infra Bot: Heads up - shadow rotation assignments posted. Lina M assigned to oncall-shadow (no high-sev pages) starting 1765008000.
Lina M: Cool. Once I have PD access can someone run a test page so I can practice ack + phone escalation?
Omar V: Yes. After IdP sync completes, Sam from infra will send PD invite. Then we'll do a live low-sev test. Also make sure your phone number is verified in PD profile.
IdP Team Bot: Manual sync completed (sync-1765004352).
Priya S: Sam, can you send the PD invite to lina.martinez@redwood.com and set role=shadow?
Omar V: Also quick note on runbooks: the Confluence page has the canonical escalation matrix and contains links to the staging playbooks in GitHub. Follow the "staging-handbook" exercises before touching prod commands.
Lina M: I accepted PD invite but when I tried to acknowledge the low-sev test page I got "insufficient permissions".
Priya S: That indicates PD role mapping didn't apply. @IdP Team Bot please re-sync the group mapping to PD.
IdP Team Bot: Sync to PagerDuty (mapping-1765004389) executed. No errors reported.
Lina M: Ack works now! I saw the phone callback and the incident meta. Thanks.
Omar V: For escalation timings we follow the runbook: 0-2 mins initial ack, 2-6 mins call primary, 6-15 mins escalate to infra lead via PD, >15 mins declare incident and follow IC checklist. The runbook has phone numbers + policy names.
Lina M: One small doc inconsistency I found: the staging drain command example in GH lacks the --dry-run flag in one spot. I can open a PR to fix it if that's helpful.
Priya S: Please do. Tag it [onboarding-docs] so we can track. Also drop a short onboarding note into the Confluence "recent onboardings" table after you finish shadowing.
Lina M: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/512 (fixes drain example, adds note about Okta visibility steps).
Omar V: Nice. We'll review. Also ping me if you want a quick phone escalation drill tonight (5-10 mins). Good to verify voice call flow.
Lina M: I'll take that drill. One last question: during shadow rotation, am I allowed to trigger staging failover exercises or only observe?
Priya S: Shadow can run staging exercises with a lead present. Do not run prod failovers until cleared. The runbook makes this explicit under "Onboarding privileges".
Lina M: Thanks everyone 44d I'll join the shadow kickoff at 10:00 tomorrow and file the confluence onboarding note after that.
